statement: FC (2026-10-18): first-order facts about what a product can do, with what, in which state, and what bears on how well it works. A function's presence is categorical; no rule derives effectiveness or performance from presence alone (checked by tests over the rules). Two mode names are one state only for a product whose document states it. pr.2 (after the first run): what is said about how the component that enables a function, or the mode that realises it, behaves is evidence about that function; a mode that realises a function makes the function present or absent with it. pr.3 (R1, 2026-10-18): evidence relations are kept apart (relevant_to, supports, refutes, a measured value of an aspect); effectiveness is assessed per aspect, and only direct statements of a test or a measurement on that aspect assess it; what is said about an enabling component is relevant, never support; an unspecified sensor is tied to no function; two modes are different states only by definition (distinct ranks of one series, highest vs lowest) or by a statement, otherwise their relation is unknown.

vocabulary.name: product
vocabulary.meaning: P is a product the document names.

vocabulary.name: function
vocabulary.meaning: F is a function the knowledge knows.

vocabulary.name: states_function
vocabulary.meaning: Statement S of the document says product P's function F is X (available or not_available).

vocabulary.name: stated_by
vocabulary.meaning: Statement S is made by B (spec_or_maker, reviewer_observed, reviewer_mention, reported_by_others).

vocabulary.name: has_component
vocabulary.meaning: Statement S says product P has component C.

vocabulary.name: component_enables
vocabulary.meaning: Knowledge: component C can enable function F (a possibility, not a fact about a product).

vocabulary.name: stated_enables
vocabulary.meaning: The document says P's component C serves P's function F.

vocabulary.name: offers_mode
vocabulary.meaning: Product P offers, or was tested in, operating mode or setting M.

vocabulary.name: mode_scale
vocabulary.meaning: Mode M is nominal, ordinal, numeric_setting or programme.

vocabulary.name: stated_equivalent
vocabulary.meaning: The document states that, on product P, mode M1 is (or runs at) M2.

vocabulary.name: function_mode
vocabulary.meaning: Knowledge: function F is used through mode M (auto mode is used by selecting the auto mode).

vocabulary.name: result
vocabulary.meaning: R is a value of metric or kind Q for product P.

vocabulary.name: result_mode
vocabulary.meaning: Result R was obtained in operating mode or setting M.

vocabulary.name: performs
vocabulary.meaning: Statement O says how well product P's function F works or behaves.

vocabulary.name: performance_evidence
vocabulary.meaning: Statement O rests on E (measured, observed_in_test, experience_in_use, opinion, manufacturer_claim, reported_by_others).

vocabulary.name: need_function
vocabulary.meaning: A buyer's need N asks for function F.

vocabulary.name: function_available
vocabulary.meaning: Some statement says P has F.

vocabulary.name: function_absent
vocabulary.meaning: Some statement says P lacks F.

vocabulary.name: presence
vocabulary.meaning: The document's verdict on P's function F: available, not_available or conflicting.

vocabulary.name: presence_not_verified
vocabulary.meaning: No statement of the record says whether P has F (closed over the record, not the world).

vocabulary.name: may_support
vocabulary.meaning: P has a component that can enable F, but no statement says P has F: a research lead, never a presence.

vocabulary.name: enabled_by
vocabulary.meaning: P's function F is served by its component C, as the document states.

vocabulary.name: effectiveness_evidence
vocabulary.meaning: O, resting on E, supports, refutes or measures an aspect of how well P's F works.

vocabulary.name: has_effectiveness_evidence
vocabulary.meaning: Some aspect of how well P's F works is assessed.

vocabulary.name: effectiveness_unassessed
vocabulary.meaning: P has F, and nothing in the record says how well it works: presence is not performance.

vocabulary.name: same_state
vocabulary.meaning: On product P, M1 and M2 are the same operating state: the same name, or a stated equivalence.

vocabulary.name: same_state_results
vocabulary.meaning: Two results of one product and one metric were obtained in the same operating state.

vocabulary.name: different_state_results
vocabulary.meaning: Two results of one product and metric were obtained in different states, by definition (distinct ranks of one series; highest vs lowest) or by a statement.

vocabulary.name: same_named_setting
vocabulary.meaning: Two results of different products and one metric at the same named setting: a match of names, not shown to be the same physical state.

vocabulary.name: need_met_by_presence
vocabulary.meaning: P has the function need N asks for; whether it works well is a separate question.

vocabulary.name: need_presence_unverified
vocabulary.meaning: Whether P has the function need N asks for is not verified.

vocabulary.name: need_effectiveness_unassessed
vocabulary.meaning: P has the function need N asks for, but how well it works is unassessed.

vocabulary.name: performs_via
vocabulary.meaning: Statement O says how well product P's component (K=component) or mode (K=mode) X works or behaves.

vocabulary.name: mode_realises
vocabulary.meaning: Knowledge: mode M is the means of function F (laundry mode realises laundry drying).

vocabulary.name: sensor_based
vocabulary.meaning: Knowledge: function F acts on a sensor's reading.

vocabulary.name: performance_what
vocabulary.meaning: Statement O is about aspect W of a function's behaviour (response time, air quality reached, energy...).

vocabulary.name: performance_polarity
vocabulary.meaning: Statement O judges positively, negatively, mixed or neutrally.

vocabulary.name: result_kind
vocabulary.meaning: Result R is a value of quantity kind K.

vocabulary.name: effectiveness_kind
vocabulary.meaning: Knowledge: a value of kind K measures aspect W of function F (power and energy measure the energy of auto mode).

vocabulary.name: function_what
vocabulary.meaning: Knowledge: W is an aspect of how well F works.

vocabulary.name: mode_rank
vocabulary.meaning: Mode M is rank N of ordinal series S (speed 3).

vocabulary.name: mode_extreme
vocabulary.meaning: Mode M is the highest or the lowest setting.

vocabulary.name: stated_different
vocabulary.meaning: The document states that, on P, M1 and M2 are different states.

vocabulary.name: test_evidence
vocabulary.meaning: E is evidence from a test or a measurement.

vocabulary.name: evidence_relation
vocabulary.meaning: Statement or result O, resting on E, stands in relation REL (relevant_to) to aspect W of P's function F.

vocabulary.name: direct_evidence
vocabulary.meaning: O is about the function itself or the mode that realises it, not about a component.

vocabulary.name: supports
vocabulary.meaning: O, a test or a measurement, says P's F works well on aspect W: a conclusion bounded to O's product, method and conditions.

vocabulary.name: refutes
vocabulary.meaning: O, a test or a measurement, says P's F works badly on aspect W (bounded likewise).

vocabulary.name: measures_aspect
vocabulary.meaning: O is a measured value of aspect W of P's F: data to compare, not a verdict.

vocabulary.name: aspect_assessed
vocabulary.meaning: Aspect W of P's F is supported, refuted or measured.

vocabulary.name: aspect_unassessed
vocabulary.meaning: P has F, and nothing in the record assesses aspect W.

vocabulary.name: aspect_controversial
vocabulary.meaning: The record both supports and refutes aspect W of P's F.

vocabulary.name: state_relation_unknown
vocabulary.meaning: Two results of one product and metric were obtained in modes the record shows neither to be the same state nor different states.

vocabulary.name: state_relation_controversial
vocabulary.meaning: The record shows two results' modes both to be the same state and different states.

vocabulary.name: presence_basis
vocabulary.meaning: A statement that P has F is made by B (spec or maker, reviewer observed, reviewer mention, reported by others).

vocabulary.name: presence_verified_in_use
vocabulary.meaning: A reviewer states having used or tested P's F: presence observed, not only declared.

vocabulary.name: presence_declared_only
vocabulary.meaning: P's F is stated present, but no statement reports using or testing it.

programs.statement: Functions, components, modes, results and statements about how well functions work, linked by typed relations.

rules.statement: a statement says P has F.
a statement says P lacks F.
P has F: stated, and no statement says otherwise.
P lacks F: stated, and no statement says otherwise.
the record says both: an unresolved question, never resolved by a vote.

rules.rule: presence_not_verified(P,F) :- product(P), function(F), not function_available(P,F), not function_absent(P,F).
rules.statement: nothing in the record says whether P has F; missing evidence is not absence.

rules.rule: may_support(P,C,F) :- has_component(_,P,C), component_enables(C,F), not function_available(P,F), not function_absent(P,F).
rules.statement: a component that can enable F is a lead for research, never evidence that P has F.
the document links P's component to P's function.
a mode is the same state as itself.
a mode a result was obtained in is the same state as itself.
a stated equivalence makes two names one state, for that product only.
equivalence is symmetric.

rules.rule: same_state_results(R1,R2) :- result(R1,P,Q), result(R2,P,Q), R1 != R2, result_mode(R1,M1), result_mode(R2,M2), same_state(P,M1,M2).
rules.statement: two results of one product and metric in one state.

rules.rule: same_named_setting(R1,R2) :- result(R1,P1,Q), result(R2,P2,Q), P1 != P2, result_mode(R1,M), result_mode(R2,M).
rules.statement: two products at the same named setting: names match, the physical states are not shown to.
the product has the function asked for.
whether the product has it is not verified.
it has it; how well it works is unassessed.
a statement about how the function behaves is relevant to the aspect it is about, whatever its evidence.

rules.rule: evidence_relation(P,F,O,W,relevant_to,E) :- performs_via(O,P,component,C), component_enables(C,F), function_available(P,F), performance_what(O,W), performance_evidence(O,E).
rules.statement: what is said about an enabling component (a responsive sensor) is relevant to the function, and only relevant: the component's behaviour is one step of the function, not its result.
what is said about the mode that realises a function is relevant to that function.
a value measured in the function's mode is relevant to the aspect its kind measures (the energy of auto mode) and to no other aspect (not to control quality).
a statement about the function itself.
a statement about the mode that realises the function (the function's own means and outcome).

rules.rule: supports(P,F,O,W,E) :- evidence_relation(P,F,O,W,relevant_to,E), direct_evidence(O), test_evidence(E), performance_polarity(O,positive), function_what(F,W).
rules.statement: a positive test or measurement on an aspect of the function supports that aspect, bounded to the statement's product, method and conditions; an opinion, a claim or a component's behaviour does not.

rules.rule: refutes(P,F,O,W,E) :- evidence_relation(P,F,O,W,relevant_to,E), direct_evidence(O), test_evidence(E), performance_polarity(O,negative), function_what(F,W).
rules.statement: a negative test or measurement on an aspect refutes it, bounded likewise.
a measured value of an aspect is data to compare, not a verdict.
supported.
refuted.
measured.
nothing in the record assesses this aspect.
the record both supports and refutes the aspect: an open question, never settled by a vote.
support of an aspect.
refutation of an aspect.
a measured aspect.
some aspect is assessed.
presence is categorical and never evidence of effectiveness; relevance alone assesses nothing.

rules.rule: different_state_results(R1,R2) :- result(R1,P,Q), result(R2,P,Q), R1 != R2, result_mode(R1,M1), result_mode(R2,M2), mode_rank(M1,S,N1), mode_rank(M2,S,N2), N1 != N2.
rules.statement: two ranks of one ordinal series are different states.

rules.rule: different_state_results(R1,R2) :- result(R1,P,Q), result(R2,P,Q), R1 != R2, result_mode(R1,M1), result_mode(R2,M2), mode_extreme(M1,highest), mode_extreme(M2,lowest).
rules.statement: the highest and the lowest setting are different states.

rules.rule: different_state_results(R1,R2) :- result(R1,P,Q), result(R2,P,Q), R1 != R2, result_mode(R1,M1), result_mode(R2,M2), mode_extreme(M1,lowest), mode_extreme(M2,highest).
rules.statement: likewise.

rules.rule: different_state_results(R1,R2) :- result(R1,P,Q), result(R2,P,Q), R1 != R2, result_mode(R1,M1), result_mode(R2,M2), stated_different(P,M1,M2).
rules.statement: a stated difference, for that product.

rules.rule: state_relation_unknown(R1,R2) :- result(R1,P,Q), result(R2,P,Q), R1 != R2, result_mode(R1,M1), result_mode(R2,M2), not same_state(P,M1,M2), not different_state_results(R1,R2).
rules.statement: sleep vs speed 1, speed 4 vs top: neither the same state nor different states is shown; the relation is unknown, not a difference.
both shown: an open question.
who states that P has F.
presence observed in use or in a test.
stated present, not observed in use (in this record).
